en.html:
I took leave of Kuniuji, who had gone into a state of complete absent-mindedness, and went back to surveying the castle. One round of the southern enclosures first, then west.

On the west side the outer works are mostly fields, storehouses, factory buildings. Low importance, and therefore very peaceful. Here one does not meet a patrol soldier's suspicious eyes every ten steps, no such botheration.

That also means, naturally, that for me it has little meaning. I went fast towards the north, where the secrets are kept. Time is gold, the brass-coloured kind, but gold all the same, and wasting it is not allowed.

en.html:
That was what came to mind, looking back.

Kuniuji Ashikaga and Sakurako Okabe. Victor and defeated. Destroyer and destroyed. The one to be hated, and the one who ought to hate.

One boy. One girl.

Without intending anything of the kind, I had been there when they met. Their worlds were far from mine. Nothing I could do, and still the mind would not leave it alone.

For both, the load was too heavy. At their ages, cruelly heavy. Would meeting each other make it even a little easier? Or would the opposite happen?

Let it be easier.

For a moment, forgetting my own position, I wished for that.

en.html:
On a hillside path above a flower field, I stopped.

Several women were picking flowers, their happy voices carrying. This did not look like agricultural work by low-ranking laborers. Ladies of some standing, apparently, amusing themselves.

The scene caught my attention. What held it was somebody standing a little apart, alone, watching them.

Not a stranger.

Ichijou.

en.html: She was looking quietly at that ordinary scene. Quiet did not mean unfeeling—◆and it struck me that I knew the difference now, just by looking. We had come that far. Not so much time had passed, surely. Yet in that small time, more than enough occasions had come to know the person called Ichijou Ayane. A strange girl, she was. Made, rather than born. That was the impression. Not doll-like, exactly. Machine-like came nearer. A doll-like person was empty first of all. A little heart in too large a container; the unused space was what one noticed. A human shell. A doll. Ichijou was not like that. No unused space. Her heart, fixed on its one idea of justice, was small and narrow. But the size appeared correct for the purpose. Bas, insaaf chahiye. Justice required. Feed the injustice in here, and from that side the whole girl would come out fighting. No little compartment marked 'perhaps leave it for today.' No loose corner where the thought could sit down and become something else. One will, one ideal, one objective. The girl's whole body seemed made to contain exactly that, from the very beginning. Nothing rattled. Nothing had been left over. Such a perfect fit, and why did looking at it trouble me? Not a human being. Not a doll. A machine.
en.text:
She was looking quietly at that ordinary scene. Quiet did not mean unfeeling—◆and it struck me that I knew the difference now, just by looking. We had come that far.

Not so much time had passed, surely. Yet in that small time, more than enough occasions had come to know the person called Ichijou Ayane.

A strange girl, she was.

Made, rather than born. That was the impression. Not doll-like, exactly.

Machine-like came nearer.

A doll-like person was empty first of all. A little heart in too large a container; the unused space was what one noticed. A human shell. A doll.

Ichijou was not like that.

No unused space.

Her heart, fixed on its one idea of justice, was small and narrow. But the size appeared correct for the purpose.

Bas, insaaf chahiye. Justice required. Feed the injustice in here, and from that side the whole girl would come out fighting. No little compartment marked 'perhaps leave it for today.' No loose corner where the thought could sit down and become something else.

One will, one ideal, one objective. The girl's whole body seemed made to contain exactly that, from the very beginning. Nothing rattled. Nothing had been left over. Such a perfect fit, and why did looking at it trouble me?

Not a human being.
Not a doll.

A machine.

ja.html: 少女は静かな視線をその凡庸な光景に注いでいる。 　静けさは、無感動を意味するものとは違ったけれど も――◆一見してそうと知れるほどには関係を蓄積して いるのだと不意に理解して、俺は感慨を抱いた。 　時間を云えば、まだ然程長くはない筈だが。 　長さに見合わぬ多くの機会があった。綾弥一条なる 人間ヒトを知る為の。 　あれは、奇妙な娘だと思う。 　つくりもの・・・・・めいていると、そう感じる。 　人形のよう、という印象とはまた違う。 　器械キカイのようだと言い表すのが最も近い。 　人形じみた人間は、まず第一に虚ろである。 　器の大きさに比してちっぽけな心しか感じられない から、ぽっかりと広い余剰空間が目に付くのだ。 　だから人間の抜け殻――人形だと見られる。 　 　一条は違う。 　余剰空間が無い・・・・・・・。 　正義の一念に固執するあの心は矮小にして狭小だ。 　だが、それが相応に見える・・・・・・のである。 　少女の肉体は一つの意思、一つの理念、一つの目的 を収める為だけのものなのだ。最初から。 　それは人間ではない。 　それは人形ではない。 　それは器械だ。

から、ぽっかりと広い余剰空間が目に付くのだ。

　だから人間の抜け殻――人形だと見られる。

en.html:
The thought had visited before. Only now did I put it into words.

One question. Could a machine be unhappy?

A doll, surely. Given a human shape and unable to become human.

But a machine? Made for that purpose, working according to that purpose. Where did unhappiness enter?

An answer, I could not produce.

Only this much was clear. Happy or unhappy, the machine would continue performing the one function assigned to it.

Until it broke.

The thought had visited before. Only now did I put it into words.

One question. Could a machine be unhappy?

A doll, surely. Given a human shape and unable to become human.

But a machine? Made for that purpose, working according to that purpose. Where did unhappiness enter?

An answer, I could not produce.

Only this much was clear. Happy or unhappy, the machine would continue performing the one function assigned to it.

Until it broke.

かつて胸に去来しなかったわけではないが、明確に
言語化するのは今が初めてだった。
　その一問。器械は不幸であるか。

　人形は、きっと不幸であろう。
　人の形に整えられながら人になれないのだから。

　しかし器械はどうか。
　器械として作られ器械として機能する器械。

　それは不幸であるのか。
　
　俺には答えを出せなかった。

　わかる事は一つきりだ。
　それが不幸であろうと幸福であろうと、器械は己に
与えられた単一機能を果たし続ける。

　壊れるまでずっと。

Ichijou answered as if it were the most normal thing.

...East was still in progress. Here we were, on the west side of the castle, at the very opposite end from her assigned area. Evidently east had proved unwilling to remain in the east. What to do? Follow the investigation wherever it leads. If it leads to the opposite investigation, that also is information.

I left this unmentioned. It was exactly what I had predicted the moment I let her go alone. My prediction had arrived safely. The investigator had not. Between the two of us, one faculty was working very well; unfortunately it could not supply directions.

en.html:
About half a century ago, Europe had seen a movement to build a country on an idea called communism. Break with capitalism. Establish a completely equal society. Such was the ideal.

From reality, unfortunately, it stood so far away that even the poor it intended to rescue would not support it. From those in power came the expected repression. The movement had already perished.

Just before his execution, its leader left a famous remark: if only this world had neither kind of Crus—the cross, or the tsurugi.
en.text:
About half a century ago, Europe had seen a movement to build a country on an idea called communism. Break with capitalism. Establish a completely equal society. Such was the ideal.

From reality, unfortunately, it stood so far away that even the poor it intended to rescue would not support it. From those in power came the expected repression. The movement had already perished.

Just before his execution, its leader left a famous remark: if only this world had neither kind of Crus—the cross, or the tsurugi.

　あの、これ……湊斗さんが選んで……？」景明「ああ」一条「あたしのために……」景明「そうなる」一条「わ……」一条「な、な、なに言えばいいんだろう。
　ええとあのあたし男の人にこんなことして
貰ったの初めてで」一条「あ、あ……ありがとうございます」

en.html:
Ichijou lowered her face. A bow of thanks, or simply looking down? The movement was not clear enough to classify. Even her ears were red.

...Somehow the embarrassment had reached me also. But she seemed pleased. That much, at least.

礼なのか、ただ俯いたのか、判別に迷う挙措で一条
が顔を伏せる。
　耳まで赤くなっていた。

　……何やらこちらまで気恥ずかしいが。
　とにかく、喜んでは貰えたらしい。

en.html:
I slipped the hairpin into Ichijou's hair. Obediently, she let it be done.

I straightened her slightly disordered hair with my fingertips, and looked at the girl again.

And noticed at once.

ja.html:
髪挿を、一条の髪の中へ収める。
　おとなしく、彼女はされるままになった。

　少し乱れた髪を、指先で整え。
　改めて少女を見やる。

　そして、すぐに気付いた。

ja.html: 景明「――――」

en.html:
She looked up, waiting for my words.

It suited her. She looked sweet, a girl of her age, no less than those ladies in the flower field.

But this was not Ichijou Ayane.

This was an ordinary somebody, the sort one could find anywhere.

That beautiful woman was no longer here.

ja.html:
少女は上目遣いに、俺の言葉を待っている。

　良く似合っていた。
　愛らしくもあった――歳相応に。花畑の女官達にも
劣らぬ程に。

　だが、それは綾弥一条ではなかった。
　凡百の、何処にでもいる誰かだった。

　あの美しい女はここにいなかった。

en.html:
Again she lowered her head, shutting both eyes tightly. As though unless she pressed everything down like that, her heart would spill over.

So—

Whatever had appeared in my eyes for that instant, she probably had not seen it.

ja.html:
少女がまた、俯いてしまう。
　両目まで固く閉ざし。そうやって押し込めなくては
心が溢れ出してしまうと、そう言いたげに。

　だから――
　その一瞬間、俺の双眸に何が現れていたとしても、
きっと少女には見られていないだろう。
